summary: RC1 regression: verified security headers change in next.config.js is non-breaking on public/unauthenticated pages. Headers correctly applied at edge (X-Content-Type-Options:nosniff, X-Frame-Options:DENY, CSP frame-ancestors 'none', Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS). Cache-Control:no-store confirmed on /dashboard,/portal,/mobile responses. All public routes (/, /login, /q/anytoken) return 200 and render correctly. Protected routes correctly 307 -> /login when logged out. Homepage hero pexels image loads (960x640, not broken), estimate form flow works end-to-end (fills name+phone, submits, estimate-summary shows 'coming soon' message + call button). Login page renders email/password/submit inputs and /brand/login-art.jpg loads. /q/anytoken renders branded 'Quote unavailable' invalid-token state. No CSP violations in browser console. Only 1 console error observed: a benign 400 from an unrelated resource (not CSP/header related).
critical_code_review_comments: CSP is minimal (only frame-ancestors 'none'); consider expanding to include script-src/img-src/connect-src default-src policies for defense-in-depth in a follow-up (non-blocking).
Benign non-CSP 400 error observed in console on public pages — worth a quick check by main agent to identify the failing request (likely a Supabase session probe on unauth pages).
test_credentials: N/A — explicitly instructed not to log in
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security headers verified at edge via curl and via Playwright on the deployed preview URL. All public data-testids present: hero-estimate-btn, header-estimate-btn, staff-login-link, estimate-name-input, estimate-phone-input, estimate-submit-btn, estimate-summary, estimate-summary-call-btn, login-email, login-password, login-submit. Protected routes redirect 307 to /login?next=... as expected. next/image with images.pexels.com works (allowed in next.config remotePatterns).
